comparison: Both paths use the same copied probe binary, timers, warm workspace and immutable prefix. The reference disables shared KV before workspace planning. The candidate uses the runtime selection.
scope: The 128-token checkpoint exercises the per-head path on both arms. Each candidate replay at 1024 and 4096 tokens should use shared KV for all 196 layer calls.
numerical_gate: Match prompt, logits, committed KV, payload bytes and generated IDs to PR 77 at every checkpoint. Match all replay outputs to their checkpoint reference. Candidate workspace bytes must stay within the reference peak.
timing_gate: At 4096 tokens require an attention median ratio at most 0.90, a complete decode median ratio at most 0.97 and at least three of four adjacent pairs faster for each metric. At 1024 tokens require attention at most 0.90 and complete decode at most 1.05. Ratios use candidate divided by reference.
control: Report the 128-token ratio and spread as a same-path control. Retain the first complete or partial result and all pairs.
